changelog.en: The Add-on Store now stays available when its usual web address cannot be reached: it then switches to the store's second address by itself. Nothing changes in how you use it.
changelog.de: Der Add-on Store bleibt jetzt erreichbar, wenn seine übliche Webadresse nicht antwortet: Er wechselt dann selbstständig zur zweiten Adresse des Stores. An der Bedienung ändert sich nichts.
changelog.fr: L'Add-on Store reste désormais accessible lorsque son adresse web habituelle ne répond pas : il passe alors de lui-même à la seconde adresse du Store. Rien ne change dans son utilisation.
changelog.it: L'Add-on Store ora resta raggiungibile anche quando il suo indirizzo web abituale non risponde: passa da solo al secondo indirizzo dello Store. Nell'uso non cambia nulla.
changelog.es: El Add-on Store ahora sigue disponible cuando su dirección web habitual no responde: cambia por sí solo a la segunda dirección de la tienda. Su uso no cambia.
changelog.nl: De Add-on Store blijft nu bereikbaar als het gebruikelijke webadres niet reageert: hij schakelt dan zelf over naar het tweede adres van de Store. In het gebruik verandert er niets.
changelog.pt: O Add-on Store continua agora acessível quando o seu endereço web habitual não responde: passa automaticamente para o segundo endereço da loja. Nada muda na forma de o utilizar.
changelog.da: Add-on Store kan nu stadig nås, når den sædvanlige webadresse ikke svarer: Den skifter så selv til butikkens anden adresse. Der ændres intet i brugen.
changelog.fi: Add-on Store on nyt käytettävissä myös silloin, kun sen tavallinen verkko-osoite ei vastaa: se siirtyy tällöin itse kaupan toiseen osoitteeseen. Käyttö ei muutu.
changelog.nb: Add-on Store er nå tilgjengelig også når den vanlige nettadressen ikke svarer: Den bytter da selv til butikkens andre adresse. Bruken endres ikke.
changelog.sv: Add-on Store går nu att nå även när dess vanliga webbadress inte svarar: den byter då själv till butikens andra adress. Inget ändras i hur du använder den.
changelog.pl: Add-on Store jest teraz dostępny także wtedy, gdy jego zwykły adres internetowy nie odpowiada: sam przełącza się wtedy na drugi adres sklepu. Sposób korzystania się nie zmienia.
changelog.cs: Add-on Store je nyní dostupný i tehdy, když jeho obvyklá webová adresa neodpovídá: sám se pak přepne na druhou adresu obchodu. Na používání se nic nemění.
changelog.hu: Az Add-on Store most akkor is elérhető marad, ha a szokásos webcíme nem válaszol: ilyenkor magától átvált az áruház második címére. A használat nem változik.
changelog.ru: Add-on Store теперь остаётся доступным, даже если его обычный веб-адрес не отвечает: он сам переключается на второй адрес магазина. В работе ничего не меняется.
changelog.tr: Add-on Store artık her zamanki web adresi yanıt vermediğinde de erişilebilir kalıyor: bu durumda mağazanın ikinci adresine kendiliğinden geçer. Kullanımda hiçbir şey değişmez.
changelog.zh-Hans: 现在，当 Add-on Store 的常用网址无法访问时，它仍可使用：会自动切换到商店的第二个地址。使用方式不变。
changelog.zh-Hant: 現在，當 Add-on Store 的常用網址無法連線時，它仍可使用：會自動切換到商店的第二個位址。使用方式不變。
changelog.ja: Add-on Store の通常の Web アドレスに接続できない場合でも、ストアを引き続き利用できるようになりました。その場合はストアの 2 つ目のアドレスに自動で切り替わります。操作方法は変わりません。
changelog.ko: 이제 Add-on Store의 기본 웹 주소에 연결할 수 없을 때도 스토어를 계속 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 경우 스토어의 두 번째 주소로 자동 전환됩니다. 사용 방법은 바뀌지 않습니다.
changelog.ar: يبقى Add-on Store متاحاً الآن حتى عندما لا يستجيب عنوانه المعتاد على الويب: إذ ينتقل تلقائياً إلى العنوان الثاني للمتجر. لا يتغير شيء في طريقة الاستخدام.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK incl. BCrypt/Crypt32 for SHA-256 and the ECDSA signature check, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset 3.14 (build tool only): since 1.9.13 it contains no WiX runtime parts (own dialogs, texts and banner; the quote page opens through explorer.exe; Windows Installer's Restart Manager closes Power PDF on request), checked in the Binary, CustomAction and Dialog tables of all 21 language versions. No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). Since 1.9.8 the setup shows, on a Power PDF licensed with a serial number, a dialog whose button "Request a quote" opens Tungsten Automation's public quote page in the default browser (only on that click, never in silent installs); the setup itself sends nothing. The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client. Since 1.9.11 the store window page uses the Tungsten Plug-in UI kit 1.0.1 (client/third_party/tpui: own code of Tungsten Automation, MIT; CSS inlined into the page at build time, no network access).

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog, search and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language, the beta channel flag and, only when the user or IT entered one, the customer code of a delivery (X-Customer-Code header). The catalog is also read once in the background about 15 seconds after Power PDF starts and after the store window closes, to show the update badge (IT can switch this off with the policy UpdateBadge = 0). No personal data, no documents.

externalServices.name: Tungsten Automation quote page (setup only, serial-number Power PDF)
externalServices.data: None from the setup: the button opens the public page in the default browser (tungstenautomation.de for German, .fr for French, .com otherwise); the browser then talks to that website as with any link.

elevation.reason: Installing, updating and removing add-ons writes to Power PDF's Plug-Ins folder in Program Files: one PowerShell step runs elevated after the UAC prompt, only when the user installs, updates or removes an add-on (the self-update starts msiexec the same way).
